figures.caption: Figure 1: GRAFT-EEG and its access contract. a–c, Quotient reference and transport of native active sensors to a fixed eight-dimensional bilateral motor basis. d, Source-side signals and transported latent. e–g, Static full-trial spectral logit plus a bounded short-window residual before the sigmoid. h, Leave-one-dataset-out evaluation and matched FI/SSI controls. i, Geometry is available before lock, signals only at inference, and labels only at scoring; target-derived fitting, normalization, calibration, and model selection are prohibited.

Figure 2: Data-grounded architecture and one sealed replay. a, In Cho2017:0, 60/64 sensors remain active over 600 samples. Separate quotient and basis-transport branches project the retained signals and geometry to the shared eight-dimensional latent; traces and As, B, G(ρ), and Z come from the label-blind replay. b, A frozen three-band, eight-mode static anchor is paired with an 11-window, 24-feature branch whose source-fitted SSM shares Wc, Wg, and Wa and contributes a bounded 2 tanh residual. The trial gives ℓs = −0.629, rSSM = +0.142, ℓ = −0.487, and p(y = 1 | X) = 0.381. Only target geometry is available before lock; all fitting, normalization, calibration, threshold selection, and model selection are source-only. Appendix L gives the full replay and stored parameters.

Figure 3: Physical-leadfield mechanism controls and strict cross-dataset performance. a, Left: physical FULL minus the layout-aware coordinate basis by target and overall. Right: equal-target effects for all four exact same-parent controls; intervals use 20,000 target-stratified paired-subject bootstrap replicates after averaging five seeds within subject, and every Holm-adjusted P < 0.001. All controls retain the split, features, head, ridge rule, budget, and target queues; the replacement operator is the only intended change. b, Strict-clean 5/5 balanced-accuracy matrix for all 15 complete methods. c, Dynamic GRAFT-EEG versus BIOT for the same 253 held-out subjects. Diamonds denote target means and the dashed line denotes identity. The operator ladder is post-hoc and not independent external validation.
